stemMd: Five seats are in a row. L sits somewhere left of M, M somewhere left of N, and O is first. P is last. Who occupies the middle seat?
explanationMd: O and P fix the endpoints. L, M and N fill seats two through four in their required relative order. M therefore occupies seat three, the middle.

distractorRationale.a: L must precede M in the three available seats.
distractorRationale.e: O is explicitly assigned to the first seat.
distractorRationale.d: P is explicitly assigned to the last seat.
